'''Pâté Chinois''' ('''Chinese Pie'''), sometimes known as [[Cookbook:Shepherd's Pie|shepherd's pie]], is a simple dish made from layered hamburger, creamed corn, and mashed potatoes. 

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) lean ground [[Cookbook:Beef|hamburger]] [[Cookbook:Meat|meat]]
*3–4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Mashed Potatoes|mashed potatoes]]
*12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (341 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] or 1 can) [[Cookbook:Creamed Corn|creamed corn]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]], and [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] to taste
*1–2 cups shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|Cheddar]] or Mexican blend [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (optional, amount depends on how much cheese you want)

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (175°C)
#In a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]], brown the hamburger meat until it is no longer pink
#In a medium [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]], evenly layer the meat on the bottom, then corn. Spread a layer of potatoes.
#If using, sprinkle cheese on top.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Possible toppings include paprika, parsley, ketchup or green tomato chow-chow (ketchup vert).
* Other variations include frying the meat with a diced onion, as well as using an equal combination of creamed corn and regular corn.
* See also [[Cookbook:Shepherd's Pie|Shepherd's Pie]] and [[Cookbook:Shepherds Pie (Pâté Chinois)|Pâté chinois]].

==Warnings==
*Always follow safe handling guidelines when using raw meat.
